comparison.profile: Actually Additions active crusher, 1/100/1000, before and after reverse-position index

source_delta_recorded_for_the_comparison.change: State gains machine_position_owners: HashMap<String, usize>; initialize it empty; on handle creation, format dimension:x,y,z and increment its reference count; on handle removal, decrement and remove the key at zero; replace owns_machine_position's scan over positions.values() and per-entry format! with machine_position_owners.contains_key(pos).
source_delta_recorded_for_the_comparison.lookup_expression_before: self.positions.values().any(|(dimension, x, y, z)| pos == format!("{dimension}:{x},{y},{z}"))
source_delta_recorded_for_the_comparison.index_lifecycle_before: No reverse index; ownership membership scanned positions on every call.
source_delta_recorded_for_the_comparison.index_lifecycle_after: On create: key = format!("{dimension}:{x},{y},{z}"); retain_machine_position_owner(&mut state.machine_position_owners, key). On removal: release_machine_position_owner(&mut state.machine_position_owners, &pos).
source_delta_recorded_for_the_comparison.helpers: retain_machine_position_owner increments; release_machine_position_owner is a no-op for absent keys and removes a key only when its count reaches zero.
